text:
Aisha Patel: Hey team, vendor CloudLedger sent invoice INV-2026-0743 and it looks like line items 2 and 3 are duplicates (same SKU, qty, price). No PO number printed on the invoice PDF link: https://files.redwood.com/ap/INV-2026-0743.pdf Can someone confirm matching and routing?
Jonah Kim: ack, will take a look. Do we have a PO for this vendor for March shipments?
Priya Nair: I can check procurement records. Vendor normally uses PO 78923 for the quarterly license renewal — is that the one?
Aisha Patel: we have PO 78923 on the contract, but AP import didn't find a PO on the invoice so it didn't auto-match. AP log shows it routed to "no-po" bucket.
FinanceBot: AP import 1894012350 processed invoice INV-2026-0743, status: routed -> no-po, potential duplicate lines flagged.
Jonah Kim: can you paste the line items? I want to verify if it's truly duplicated or two separate billing periods.
Aisha Patel: items copied below:
 - CL-CPU-500 2 x $4,200 = $8,400
 - CL-CPU-500 2 x $4,200 = $8,400
 - Support-ANNUAL 1 x $3,000 = $3,000
Subtotal: $19,800
Tax: $0
Total: $19,800
Jonah Kim: yep that's identical. Looks like vendor accidentally re-exported one shipment. If PO exists, we can match to PO 78923 but need vendor confirmation. If not, we should hold payment and request corrected invoice/credit.
Priya Nair: pinging vendor contact. @CloudLedger Support — can you confirm whether the duplicated CL-CPU-500 line should be removed or if they're separate deliveries?
CloudLedger Support: Hi Priya, thanks for flagging. Sorry about that — a billing system re-sync duplicated the item. We will issue a corrected invoice and a credit for the duplicate. Expect corrected INV-2026-0743-REV by EOD and a credit memo CM-2026-004. Apologies for the noise.
Aisha Patel: thanks. I'll put a hold in AP and note "pending corrected invoice / credit". Jonah, please do not approve routing to payment.
Jonah Kim: marked hold in Cortex AP queue and added note. :no_entry_sign:
Priya Nair: I'll update PO 78923 notes to reflect pending credit so procurement doesn't reconcile early.
FinanceBot: AP hold applied to INV-2026-0743 by Aisha Patel at 1894012400.
Aisha Patel: once we receive the corrected invoice, can someone confirm the invoice prints the PO 78923 so it auto-matches? If vendor leaves PO off again we'll have to match manually.
CloudLedger Support: We'll ensure PO 78923 is on the revised invoice. Also sending updated remittance to ap@redwood.com.
Jonah Kim: perfect. Follow-up: if credit doesn't arrive within 3 business days, escalate to Vendor Ops. Priya, can you own that escalation?
Priya Nair: yes, I'll own escalation. Adding calendar reminder for 3 business days.
Aisha Patel: closing loop: set status -> waiting_on_vendor. Will reopen thread when revised docs arrive. :white_check_mark:
